title: Sexual and reproductive health
learning_outcomes: Explain reproductive anatomy in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
Compare and distinguish prevention and testing in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
Apply fertility literacy in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
Evaluate and justify decisions about consent and referral in the context of sexual and reproductive health.

lessons.title: Reproductive anatomy
lessons.outcome: Explain reproductive anatomy in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reproductive anatomy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to sexual health resource comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reproductive anatomy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reproductive anatomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Prevention and testing
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish prevention and testing in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving prevention and testing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to sexual health resource comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain prevention and testing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of prevention and testing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Fertility literacy
lessons.outcome: Apply fertility literacy in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving fertility literacy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to sexual health resource comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain fertility literacy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of fertility literacy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Consent and referral
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about consent and referral in the context of sexual and reproductive health.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving consent and referral; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to sexual health resource comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain consent and referral from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of consent and referral; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of reproductive anatomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of prevention and testing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of fertility literacy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of consent and referral; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
